summary: Rewrites the formulas on a sheet.
description: Pass a map to replace sheet names wholesale — the usual need after a rename or a copy — or a function to decide each formula for itself. The function receives the formula and returns the one to put back.
Only cells that hold a formula are visited, and only the ones that actually changed are written, so a no-op costs one read and nothing else.

params.rewrite: A map of old sheet name to new one, or a function taking a formula and returning its replacement.

throws.InvalidSheetException: the first argument is not a sheet.

examples.title: Rewriting formulas
